name: resources-index
description: Canonical registry of Membrane MCP resources. Lists every resource the MCP server exposes, including each resource's bounded MIME type, independent version, required access grants, and template arguments. This resource is itself read-only and requires the `protocol.read` access grant.
authorityNotes: The index exposes resource metadata only — never the body of any resource. It cannot be used to widen authority beyond `protocol.read`.

resources.name: resources-index
resources.description: Canonical registry of Membrane MCP resources.

resources.name: installation-manifest
resources.description: The active installation manifest — installation identity, release generation, components, and bound API schemas. Bounded to the caller's installation.read grant; cannot leak cross-installation.

resources.name: operation-registry
resources.description: The Membrane operation registry — every MCP tool name, its independently-versioned schemaVersion/errorVersion, and closed error code list. Bounded to the caller's protocol.read grant.

supportedGrantTypes.name: installation.read
supportedGrantTypes.description: Read access to the bound installation identity (manifest, release generation, components, bound API schemas). Issued by the Membrane supervisor at install/startup time.

supportedGrantTypes.name: protocol.read
supportedGrantTypes.description: Read access to the Membrane protocol metadata surface (operations registry, resources index, prompts index). Issued at every MCP handshake.
